# Da Nang TechX

> Da Nang Tech R&D and Networking Portal — Feed, Time Management, Money, Chat, and Friends on one install.

Public surfaces are crawlable. Signed-in app routes (tasks, epics, analytics, admin, settings, profile, auth forms, chat, friends, money) are private and should not be treated as documentation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dntechx.com/): Public hub for Da Nang TechX (five modules overview).
- [Feed](https://dntechx.com/feed): Public manuscript feed of community posts and R&D notes.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dntechx.com/privacy): What the service collects, who processes it, and how long it is kept.
- [Terms of Service](https://dntechx.com/terms): Rules for using the service, content ownership, and acceptable use.
- [Sitemap](https://dntechx.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of indexable URLs.
- [Robots](https://dntechx.com/robots.txt): Crawl rules for public vs private surfaces.

## Optional (signed-in, noindex)

- [Chat](https://dntechx.com/chat): Private messaging between Accepted friends.
- [Friends](https://dntechx.com/friends): Friend requests and Accepted graph.
- [Money](https://dntechx.com/money): Personal ledger, savings, and budgets.
- [Time](https://dntechx.com/tasks): Calendar, epics, and analytics.
